title.en: An Act Granting Aid or Compensation in the Sum of Four thousand Pesos to Julian Felipe, Author of the "Philippine National Anthem

text.en:
Aid or compensation in the sum of four thousand pesos is hereby granted to Julian Felipe, in
recognition of his inspired and meritorious production known as the "Philippine National Anthem," to be paid
to him by the.Insular Treasurer of the Philippine Islands upon delivery to the Bureau of the Philippine Library
and Museum of the original manuscript of said "Philippine National Anthem."

The sum of four thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury
not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the purposes of this Act.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 4, 1924.
